segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skinned reviewers report mixed outcomes: one used the patches with no irritation and good results, while another reported burning and a red mark forming around the mouth area and considered the patches unsuitable for sensitive skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, sensitive skin reported the patches lightened her dark acne spots effectively without triggering new breakouts.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her mid-40s saw no change on a longstanding age spot and wondered whether more mature skin responds less to the treatment, though this was offered as speculation rather than a reported worsening.

concerns.spots: Reports on dark spots, sun spots and age spots are mixed: many reviewers saw no change at all even after repeated application on the same spot, while many others describe gradual lightening after using patches on the same area for 2-3 consecutive nights, especially on post-acne marks and sun spots; one reviewer also noted the skin surrounding the spot lightened along with it.
concerns.blemishes: A smaller number of reviewers addressed active breakouts rather than marks: one reported the patches did not cause new pimples around the treated area as she had feared, and another described the patches as effective at clearing pimples directly.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers reported the patches caused new redness, burning, or red rings around the treated area, sometimes lasting several days, particularly near the mouth or on reactive skin; conversely, one reviewer used the patches specifically on small red spots from broken capillaries and reported they faded with repeated use.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reported dryness developing around the treated dark spot from the patch's adhesive, alongside no visible lightening effect.

extraits.texte: Used once in hopes of reducing hyperpigmentation on my face. Followed directions exactly. Instantly felt the microdarts pricking my skin. After a few minutes the spot felt like it was burning but thought maybe it was my skin getting used to the microdarts. Continued to burn. Removed after 15 minutes and now have large red spot on my face. Washed my face hoping it'd remove the microdarts ingredients. Still VERY red. I don't normally have reactions. I use various Cetaphil face products and Hero Mighty Patches regularly without issue.

I never write reviews but I don't want anyone to waste their money on these like I did! I used them 3 nights in a row for 8hrs and they didn't improve my dark spots. Instead, they left a red ring and dryness around the dark spots where the adhesive sticks. Even with make up on the rings are noticable. It's been 2 days since I've used them and I still have red rings on my face. No irritation though. I've used other zit and acne patches in the past and they don't leave red rings. Don't buy!

Unfortunately these have not worked for me. I was very hopeful because I love the other P&L products and happened to have an annoyingly prominent pimple two weeks before I ordered these. I thought that because the resultant dark acne scar was "fresh" these would help fade it. I used the entire pack (which is ONLY NINE patches to begin with) and wore them each overnight. They have had no effect whatever even though the packaging touts the effects at three days. It's possible my 45yo skin is too old for it to help but I was disappointed that there wasn't any change. They *might* help boost the already fast healing of younger skin but I didn't see it. I'll stick to the P&L serums and moisturizers.

They work well but when i use them around my mouth area my skin gets very VERY red and it burns. I am assuming they arent for use on sensitive skin so be careful about where you place them, I have what looks like two round burns on my face now.

I was very skeptical using these but I've tried everything to lighten my dark acne spots/scars, and these actually work! Any other products end up causing more breakouts, but where these are a sticker, I didn't have any issues. I thought for sure I'd have a line of zits around the sticker, but that never happened. You definitely have to use them 3 days back to back, but I definitely saw a major difference at day 3! I went back to purchase more because some spots I've had longer and they needed more time/stickers. But they eventually went away too. I have combination skin, very pale, and sensitive. Hope my review encourages other people to try them. They're expensive but actually worth it in my opinion!

extraits.titre: The Single Best Dark Spot Treatment I've Tried
extraits.texte: I have one stubborn age spot on my left cheek that I've tried for years to address. I have used most of the major brands out there, including a well-known prescription brand. None of them have made any difference. For the past 3 nights, I have used a Dark Spot Microdart on the age spot, and I can actually see it starting to diminish in size and intensity. I apply it to clean skin before going to bed and leave it on until I wash my face in the morning. I plan to keep using them until the spot is as lightened as I can get it. I'm so happy I finally found something that works!
These little patches are amazing! Works in a few days at really lightening up dark spots from pimples. No irritation for my sensitive skin. I highly recommend!
